locator: Nestlé BMS Index 2024 scorecard, sections « Infant formula », « Follow-up formula » and « Growing-up milk »
summary: ATNi states that Nestlé's commitments applied to 85% of its infant-formula sales, 69% of follow-up formula sales and 0% of growing-up milk sales under its assessment of policy coverage across markets. ATNi notes that Nestlé did not apply its BMS marketing commitments to growing-up milks and applied them to follow-up formulas only in higher-risk markets.
limitations: These figures measure the coverage of company policy commitments as assessed by ATNi, not the percentage of products found legally non-compliant.
